summary: Four criteria cover the new hours in the saved reply for delayed orders and the corrected reply to customers who got the old hours. A person sees the first three in a demo.

criteria.text: The saved reply for delayed orders lists the support hours as 8:00 to 20:00.
The reply states that the hours apply every day, on weekends and public holidays too.
The reply states that support is closed on 25 December.
Each customer who got the reply with the old hours receives a corrected reply that lists the new hours.
